name: BACH_0188_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (94%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Stain-degraded simulated frozen section fails reliability checks [F6], with margins deferred [F7] and recut or deeper levels drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 94%, Normal 5%, Benign 1%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Strong InSitu score, minimal invasion |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.47 reliability (flagged), 76% OOD (error AUROC 0.70) | Suspect input from stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (same top class: false) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%), 2/5 Normal [F5] | Mixed InSitu and Normal neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest anti-invasion contribution (-0.721), but 0/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 1, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.462 contribution), 20/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.326 contribution), 12/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 4) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasion (+0.279), but weak with 0/20 spot-check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Low slide-wide (-0.190), highest focal score in region 9 · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable `normal_lobules` and `mitoses` (both 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severe stain degradation (severity 3) on this simulated frozen section distorts features, as CONCH and MUSK disagree.
- True diagnosis is Normal (2/5 neighbors, including contrast case BACH_0062) or focal invasion exists in region 9.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 9**: Inspect for stromal invasion; tile invasive risk reaches 54% with focal invasion score 0.72.
2. **Regions 3, 5, 6**: Verify duct-confined atypia versus normal epithelium, and check nuclear pleomorphism in **regions 2, 3**.
3. **Regions 2, 3, 8, 9**: Review high-scoring margin segments (96%–100%); consider drafted H&E recut and deeper levels.
